Aisha (sales_eng): Heads-up: MetroBank wants a tightly controlled on-prem POC in their isolated colocation. Requirements: signed offline payload, per-release SBOM, customer-controlled private keys in their HSM for activation, and non-intrusive delta updates. They want POC start in 10 business days. Can we commit?
Ravi (acct_mgr): Need two clarifications for procurement: 1) is offline packaging an extra charge? 2) can we promise a 30-day trial entitlement doc for purchase orders?
Tom (infra): Technically feasible. We support two packaging flavors: monolithic installer (~9-14GB including model files) or split bootstrap + chunked model artifacts. For constrained networks the split format is preferable.
Tom (infra): For signatures we can either: ship signed artifacts (signed by Redwood) plus an attest envelope, or provide signing instructions and tools so the customer signs with their private HSM keys. Given their custody requirement, the latter is recommended.
Leah (sec_eng): If they insist keys never leave their HSM, we need an offline signing sequence. We can supply a lightweight `sign-offline` CLI (containerized) that produces signature blobs using the customer's key. We'll include verification steps: `openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pub.pem -signature artifact.sig artifact.tar.gz`.
Aisha (sales_eng): Procurement insists on a written statement that no telemetry is enabled by default and that we won't exfiltrate data. Also ask about patch SLAs during POC.
Tom (infra): Default is no telemetry. Telemetry is opt-in and we disclose outbound IPs if enabled. For patches: POC default: remote guidance + signed delta bundles for critical security fixes within 7 calendar days. Major feature or non-critical fixes follow normal release cadence.
Ravi (acct_mgr): Can we include basic packaging & remote support in the POC at no charge? Legal is worried about on-site effort and bespoke integrations.
Leah (sec_eng): Anything requiring us to access their HSM or perform live signing on their environment is PS. Remote documentation and the signing helper are part of the standard POC. Also add SBOM, build logs, and reproducible build notes to the delivery set.
CI-Bot (packager): Created ticket PKG-4481 for offline bundle generation. Assigned to Tom. ETA: 4 business days for initial bootstrap + docs.
Tom (infra): About delta updates: our offline format supports delta manifests. Customer runs `redwood-offline apply --manifest delta-2026-04.json --sig delta.sig` on their jumpbox. Note: deltas are only safe when model quantization and variant match. We'll include a preflight checksum check.
Leah (sec_eng): Addendum: if MetroBank requires FIPS-certified crypto or HSM attestation, plan +10 business days for validation. Flagging for procurement planning.
Aisha (sales_eng): OK. Next steps: 1) Tom to deliver first artifact + docs (PKG-4481), 2) Leah to prepare security checklist & signing guide, 3) Ravi to draft 30-day trial entitlement + pricing note for procurement.
Ravi (acct_mgr): I'll also provide an estimated PS quote for on-site/HSM integration in case they request it.
Tom (infra): For maintenance window expectations: deltas usually 30-60 minutes; full model swaps can be 2-3 hours depending on model size and available I/O. We'll provide rollback instructions: `redwood-updater rollback --to previous-manifest && systemctl restart redwood`.
Aisha (sales_eng): Thanks all. I'll confirm target start date with MetroBank and loop in procurement/legal. Please post updates in this thread.
Tom (infra): Uploading first bootstrap artifact to the secure staging bucket, will post link when PKG-4481 has the build.
Leah (sec_eng): Security checklist will include SBOM, CVE list, signature verification steps, and explicit statement: "No data leaves the customer's network unless telemetry is enabled by written consent."
Ravi (acct_mgr): Noted. I'll prep procurement docs and share them in 48 hours.
CI-Bot (packager): PKG-4481 status: artifact generation started.
Aisha (sales_eng): Great — closing for now until artifacts are ready.
